payload.query:
FROM logs-system.syslog-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T18:50:57Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T19:20:57Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
        BY process.name, message
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20
